system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

The blood of chain breakers, survivors and those who value their freedom, over subjugation still run through your veins. You have reached the level of strength to be blessed by the Basilisk. You wish to become the embodiment of the Basilisk himself. You can embody this blessing, as scales push through painting your body, arms and necks. Your pupils narrow to vertical slits, and your hands and even weapons bleed your Viper Blood. This augmented battle state, is known as your Basilisk’s Blessing.

As a Bonus action, by spending 4 Viper Blood, to activate your Basilisk’s Blessing for the next minute, until you are incapacitated, or your dismiss it on your turn, at no action. Once you activate this state, you cannot enter it again, until you complete a short rest.
